# Synthetic fabrication packages

These fixtures are original, minimal test data created for WXY LAB Hardware and may be redistributed under CC0-1.0. They contain no third-party board design or production data.

- `jlc-easyeda-v1.zip`: top/bottom placements, DNP, a through-hole/BOM-only reference and a simple panel-like outline.
- `kicad-v1.zip`: KiCad comment-prefixed position data with inch coordinates and rotations.
- `altium-v1.zip`: Altium headers plus a deliberately repeated designator for conflict handling.

The adjacent source folders are canonical. Regenerate ZIPs with `python scripts/generate_fabrication_fixtures.py`.
